item.title: Diff Decoder How-To With Aydin Horne [VIDEO]
item.description: Unlock the secrets of elite RC performance in “Factory Team Diff Decoder with Aydin Horne” – your ultimate how-to guide for mastering differential tuning in the radio control car hobby.

item.title: New RC10 DS Kit With Rally Body
item.description: With Team Associated’s RC10DS you’re entering a new and highly competitive class of RC racing with the chassis based on one of the most successful RC cars ever, the RC10.

item.title: New Revolution Design B84 Lightweight Center Driveline Sets
item.description: Designed for the Team Associated B84 with center differential, this Revolution Design lightweight center driveline set reduces rotating mass and overall drivetrain weight for faster acceleration and a more responsive feel.

item.title: New Infinity IF18-3 Low Friction Pulley Set
item.description: Infinity has released a new IF18-3 pulley set in a new material that reduces friction with the drive belt compared to conventional products while minimizing wear to the utmost extent.

item.title: New 1up Racing UltraLite Front Bumpers
item.description: 1up Racing UltraLite Front Bumpers are engineered for modern 1/10 touring car racing, combining exceptional durability with extremely low weight to preserve steering response and front-end feel.

item.title: New ProTek RC Sensor Wires, Solder, and Body Mounting Accessories
item.description: ProTek RC is releasing a series of performance and maintenance products to enhance your RC racing program. From a series of sensor wires to premium rosin core solder to aluminum body repair and protection tape to body mounting tape.

item.title: 18th Annual RC Kings Royal Announcement
item.description: D&J Raceway will be hosting the RC Kings Royal on March 7th in Wooster, Ohio. Check out the flyer for more information!

item.title: New Moto-Obscura Ball-Stud Dust Seals
item.description: Vintage racing specialists Moto-Obscura have reproduced a direct replacement for Team Associated and Team Losi dust seals, available now in packs of 24 pieces.

item.title: New Factory Team RC10 Captured Hinge Pins
item.description: Whether you are racing or bashing, these all new RC10 Factory Team Captured Hinge pins provide added durability and peace of mind when driving your favorite RC10 Vintage car.

item.title: New Revolution Design B84 Vented Decoupled Slipper Plates
item.description: The Revolution Design Vented Decoupler Slipper Plate Set is designed to keep your decoupled slipper working more consistently from start to finish.
